The '''Chamm system''' was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of the material known as [[Chammian ivory]]<ref name="TCW">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Chammian ivory]]|system=Chamm [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> and fell within the borders of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chamm [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-12.<ref name="TEA" />
